evidence: The Co@MoS2 subjected to 500 ALD cycles (with a MoS2 loading mass of 0.06 mg cm-2) exhibits outstanding OER activity requiring an overpotential of only 270 mV to deliver a current density of 10 mA cm−2, being one of the best-performing sulfide-based OER electrocatalysts and favorably comparable to the state-of-the-art noble metal electrocatalysts reported in the literature.
